Hi Emily,

I extract the underlying information (scores and loadings) for a dataset "msidata" from a pca result ("pca_result") like this:


pcaloadings = data.frame(mz(msidata),DataFrame(resultData(pca_result, 1, "loadings")))
colnames(pcaloadings)[1] = "mz"

pcascores = data.frame(DataFrame(resultData(pca_result, 1, "scores")))
pcascores = data.frame(coord(msidata)$x, coord(msidata)$y, pcascores)



Maybe that helps. PCA is great to get a quick overview of the data but spatialkmeans and spatialshrunkencentroids are normally more powerful in segmenting the data.

Best,
Melanie
